name: ch9_selected_pcc27
title: ch9_selected_shunt_gw006 with the interface setpoints priced at 27 x g_w_der (was 81)
description: i.e. g_w_pcc / g_w_der = 27 instead of 81.1. g_w_der and every other weight
are unchanged, so the TS IBG respond as before and the STS are called more.
Why: the per-actuator OFO step is -(H^T grad Phi)_i / (2 g_w,i). An interface
column and an STS-IBG column have the same norm at the TS buses, so the
price ratio decides how much the TSO asks of the STS. The ratio 81 of
ch9_selected is a by-product of the Stage-II rule, which has no criterion
on resource allocation (Stage-I start point: 1). Author goal 2026-10-16:
more STS contribution; TS-IBG activity need not be reduced.
windows W1-W4, W6, 12 h, DSO_3 x2, against ch9_selected_shunt_gw006:
recruited flow (Ch 7 eq:setup:metrics:recruit, base in place of the
no-access variant) 15.7 Mvar per STS median, e_v(TS) -4.4 %, e_v(DS) +10 %,
e_q +19 %, DSO taps worst 6 /d (was 4), shunt commits 40 -> 26, no
corridor violations. lambda_max(B) 1.357 against the 1.546 select ceiling
NOT a re-selection: the Chapter-9 rule (e_v(TS) first) would rank the
ceiling ratio 13.9 higher; ratio 27 is an author priority decision that
trades DS voltage cost and interface tracking for STS contribution.

provenance.network: rural_700, DSO_3 x2 (Chapter-9 batch); MSC on the second coupler tertiary (2026-10-15)
